messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature

message.content: The best time to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for, but generally the shoulder seasons—late spring (April–June) and early fall (September–November)—offer a great balance of pleasant weather, lower crowds, and better rates. During these months you’ll enjoy warm temperatures (mid‑70s to low‑80s °F), lower humidity, and fewer tourists compared to the peak winter and summer periods. If you’re after the absolute best weather with minimal rain, late spring (May–June) is ideal; if you want to avoid crowds while still enjoying good conditions, early fall (September–October) works well.
